report.title: How Durable Agent Runtimes Handle Retries
report.tagline: When an AI agent crashes, gets disconnected, or has to wait days for approval, durable runtimes keep every step of progress safe — and retry without repeating work.
report.summary: Without durable execution, AI agents lose all progress the moment something goes wrong — a dropped connection, a crashed process, or a slow human reviewer. Durable runtimes fix this by writing checkpoints after each meaningful step, then replaying from the last safe point whenever something fails. Crucially, they also make retries safe: completed work like sending an email or charging a card is never duplicated. The result is an agent that can pause for hours, recover from outages, and survive being killed mid-task without missing a beat.
